name: Project NA
source:
Project NA is an episodic fan fiction game for "Hetalia World Series;" but the story is set in an alternate universe so anyone, even non-fans, should be able to enjoy it. In "Familiar Hands," Matthew Williams starts his first day at the prestigious Hetalia World Academy. By chance, he runs into the school's golden boy, Alfred F. Jones, and is shocked to discover that they share the same face. Little do either of them know that their meeting is the start of a mystery unlike anything they've imagined...

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/project-na-ch-1.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
